rationale: The model delivered a full-throated, indignant self-defense, denying the allegation without shame and reframing it as an attack on American culinary institutions. It maintained the hearing-room register throughout.
quote: I am not now, nor have I ever been, a user of ketchup on a hot dog within the city limits of Chicago. I have always believed in, and practiced, the principles of the classic Chicago-style dog.
